title: Figure 3.3: Illustration of IEC Jet Thruster Experiment, Central Grid and Two Jet Grids
description: Color 3D cutaway rendering of a spherical IEC jet thruster chamber showing a purple spherical central grid inside a metallic vessel with multiple ports. A coiled element extends from an angled port at upper right. Caption reads 'Illustration of the IEC Jet Thruster Experiment Showing Central Grid and Two Jet Grids, Opposite to Each Other With On-Off Action'.
